jobs.description:
Are you passionate about cutting-edge technology?

Do you thrive on ensuring products meet the highest standards of performance and reliability?

As a Test & Validation Engineer you will be instrumental in validating advanced imaging systems, from prototype to industrialization, ensuring they meet both customer and regulatory standards. You will also mentor junior engineers and drive continuous improvement in our testing processes.

Key Responsibilities:

• Define and implement validation and verification plans for new products and platforms.
• Develop test protocols, acceptance criteria and traceability matrices.
• Conduct hands-on testing of sensors, cameras, and modules, covering electrical, optical, mechanical and environmental aspects.
• Automate test procedures using LabVIEW, Python or similar tools.
• Analyze test results, identify root causes and propose corrective actions.
• Improve test methodologies, tools and infrastructure to support scalable industrialization.
• Collaborate with R&D, project management, quality and operations teams to support design reviews and product improvements.
• Mentor junior engineers and share best practices within the team.

• Master’s degree in Electronics, Physics, Optics, or related engineering field.
• Min. 5-7 years of experience in test engineering, validation, or reliability engineering in a high-tech environment 
• Hands-on experience with test automation (Python expertise needed).
• Familiarity with optical/electro-optical testing is a strong plus.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to get to root causes.
• Excellent communication skills; capable of writing clear technical documentation and presenting to stakeholders.
• Ability to mentor and guide less experienced engineers.
• Fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch is a plus.

Are you ready for a challenging career in the FAB Engineering team? Would you like to work with the most high-tech devices? Then read on quickly!

As an Equipment Maintenance Engineer, you'll start your journey in the esteemed FAB Engineering team:

• You'll get hands-on experience with the high-tech process equipment in our cleanroom. No need to be an expert from day one – we'll give you the time to thoroughly understand these cutting-edge tools. The team takes pride in maintaining and fine-tuning some of the most advanced equipment globally. You'll even get a chance to work with first versions and prototypes, which is pretty exciting!
• You will work closely with equipment manufacturers and other process engineers, so you'll be collaborating with a diverse group of experts.
• You’ll be part of the FAB Engineering team that consists of over 100 talented individuals with whom you will form the beating heart of our research institute. Specializing in nano-electronics, your work will contribute to technological solutions in various fields like healthcare and energy.

• You hold a Master's degree in Industrial Science with a focus on Electromechanics or Mechanics, or you have acquired equivalent technical experience. If you're just starting out, that's perfectly fine! We welcome motivated beginners who are eager to launch their careers.
• You are genuinely passionate about technology and equipment, and you are not afraid to work hands-on. Your technical knowledge of pneumatics, pumps, motors, electronics, and (electro)mechanics is a valuable asset.
• We highly appreciate your collaborative spirit, while also trusting your ability to proactively plan and organize your work on your own.
• You have a very good knowledge of English.
You will work in a shift regime: early - late (6u-14u & 14u-22u) and 1 weekend every 3 weeks

What will you have to do?
 

 
• Learn how to prepare our extensive range of chocolates
 
• You’ll learn the recipes so you can perform all tasks independently
 
• You’ll keep your workstation tidy, because that’s how you prefer to work
 
• As a line operator, you’ll set up the machine according to the correct parameters and adjust them as needed.
 
• You inspect the quality of the finished products.
 
• You supply the raw materials and packaging materials to the production line.
 
• Converting machines is also part of your responsibilities, as is cleaning and maintaining the production line. 

Who are you?
 

 
• You have a degree as a chocolatier, baker, or pastry chef OR possess the necessary experience
 
• Recent graduates in the fields of chocolatier, baker, or pastry chef are also welcome
 
• You are able to work in a two-shift system (5:00 AM–1:00 PM / 1:00 PM–9:00 PM)
 
• You adhere to hygiene and safety standards
 
• You have your own transportation
 
• You have a good to very good knowledge of Dutch or English
 
• You are willing to undergo in-house training
 
• You have a truly hands-on attitude
 
• You are a team player

For our client in the Kortrijk region, we are looking for a motivated Carpet Finishing Operator to strengthen our team on the finishing line.

 

• Cutting and finishing carpets to size

• Processing carpets on the finishing line

• Carrying out quality checks

• Attaching fringes when necessary

• Ensuring a neat and high-quality finish

Job Requirements:

• You are precise and enjoy working with your hands

• You have an eye for quality and attention to detail

• You can work independently, but you are also a team player

• Experience in carpets, textiles or garment manufacturing is a plus

• Experience is not required: motivation and a positive work attitude are important

• You speak Dutch, French or English

jobs.occupation: Handyman / general facilities technician - English is allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you a hands-on technician with solid electrical knowledge and a passion for maintenance, repairs, and problem-solving? Do you enjoy having variety in your work and being the go-to person for all technical issues? And are you already living in Belgium?

For a growing transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for a multi-skilled maintenance technician or handyman to help maintain the buildings, warehouse facilities, technical installations and outdoor areas. A very varied job that combines electrical maintenance, facility maintenance, repairs, troubleshooting and general handyman tasks. And the best part: Dutch isn't required, so you can also apply if you speak English very well!

Your role

As technician, you're responsible for a wide range of maintenance and repair activities across the different sites of the company. You and the rest of the technical team use your technical skills to ensure the operations run safely and efficiently.

Your key duties:

• Perform electrical maintenance and repairs
• Carry out minor repairs to plumbing, storage racks, equipment...
• Keep up the company grounds and outdoor facilities
• Help perform maintenance and repairs to the company vehicles
• Supervise external contractors and service providers

Your profile:

• Good knowledge of electrical systems and installations
• Basic knowledge of plumbing, mechanics, building maintenance, or general technical repairs
• Experience as a maintenance technician, handyman, facilities technician, general maintenance worker...
• Own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
• Very good knowledge of English
 

!! IMPORTANT ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS: please read carefully before applying !!

• You must already be living in Belgium
• You must already have a valid legal right to work in Belgium (EU citizenship or valid work permit)
Candidates who do not meet these requirements will not be considered for the position. We do not provide visa sponsorship, work permits, relocation support or immigration assistance.

Within the Services department, you are responsible for the management (remote) of various mission critical systems installed at the customers. If a problem arises, you analyse the problem and, together with the team, find the best solution. You do not only perform classic maintenance tasks, but you are also responsible for proactively monitoring the systems, rolling out upgrades and lifecycle management. You will be trained in various new technologies. And you participate in the implementation of new installations at customers in close cooperation with the Project Engineers and Project Managers.

Implementation of projects:

• In a lab environment, you prepare future installations.
• You install the solution at the customer's site and put it into service. 
• You give training to key users and administrators.
Maintenance:

• You perform ( remote) corrective maintenance on various mission critical systems.
• You perform updates and upgrades on existing systems.
• You perform preventive visits in the context of maintenance contracts.

Profile

• Must have: Bachelor, Master or Engineer in Electronics,Information Technology, Telecommunication...
• Fluent in Dutch, good knowledge of English and French are a major assets
• Good understanding of virtualisation (VMware, Nutanix)
• Expertise in Windows server environments
• Enterprise Networking (Switching, Routing, TCP/IP)
• Expertise in Linux systems environements is an asset
• Expertise in VOIP / Video is an asset
• Analytical mind, well organised, flexibility, eagerness to learn are key in this position
• Open to participate in the on call rotation within your team after a few months of practice
• Troubleshooting Complex Critical Environments
• Technical Consulting and Customer Interaction
• Driver Licence B
• Professional with up to 4 years of experience
• Passionate about technology and eager to learn

jobs.description:

Our client is a growing company focused on IT services and professional B2B software solutions. They are currently seeking a motivatedSupport Engineer (3rd line)ready to take on technical challenges and deliver high-quality service to clients.

jobs.occupation: Program Manager - Microsoft E5 - Great Implementation
jobs.description:
SENIOR PROGRAM MANAGER - MICROSOFT 365 E5 IMPLEMENTATION
- Brussels | Hybrid

Lead a strategic Microsoft 365 E5 implementation program with direct impact across the organization.
Take ownership of a complex transformation involving multiple technical, security and business workstreams.
Drive the program from roadmap to execution, ensuring delivery, governance, budget and stakeholder alignment.
Act as the central point of coordination between IT experts, business teams, management and external partners.
Turn complex technical requirements into clear priorities, decisions and actionable plans.
Join a high-visibility transformation where autonomy, seniority and stakeholder management are non-negotiable.
Experience in a large or public-sector organization is a strong advantage.

SENIOR PROGRAM MANAGER - THE JOB:

You will…

• Own and drive the Microsoft 365 E5 implementation: scope, roadmap, governance, milestones, budget and deliverables.
• Coordinate multiple technical and business workstreams, managing dependencies, risks, priorities and delivery.
• Challenge and align technical teams and senior stakeholders, translating complex IT topics into clear decisions and actions.

SENIOR PROGRAM MANAGER - YOUR PROFILE:

You are/have…

• Minimum 7 years of experience in IT Program/Project Management, with proven experience leading large-scale transformation programs.
• Mandatory hands-on program experience with Microsoft 365 / E5 implementations or transformations. A general Microsoft background alone is not sufficient.
• Mandatory professional fluency in French, Dutch and English. Experience in the public sector, large organizations or complex regulated environments is a strong asset.
• Strong enough technically to understand, challenge and coordinate Microsoft/IT specialists without needing to be the technical implementer yourself.
• Proven ability to operate autonomously in complex, partially-defined environments with senior stakeholders.

Responsibilities

• Analyze, implement, and maintain ETL processes using Azure Data Factory and PySpark in Databricks.
• Design and develop high-performance data solutions based on specific functional requirements.
• Prepare and execute comprehensive testing activities to ensure the reliability of data pipelines.
• Perform bug fixing and optimization of pipelines during daily production runs.
• Gather and translate business requirements into detailed functional and technical specifications.
• Manage database modeling tasks using specialized tools such as Erwin or Visio.

Requirements

• 3+ years of experience with Azure cloud data platforms including Data Lake Gen2 and Synapse.
• 3+ years of experience with Databricks and Python programming for data engineering.
• 3+ years of experience in Azure Data Factory and Data Flow.
• 3+ years of experience in DevOps practices, including Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD.
• 3+ years of experience in Power BI and semantic data modeling.
• You bring knowledge of data management principles such as metadata management, lineage, and data quality.
• You possess experience in database modeling using Erwin or Visio.
• You have the ability to handle analytics use cases and translate complex business requirements.
• You're proactive, solution-oriented, and able to work both independently and in a collaborative team environment.
• You are fluent in Dutch or French with basic knowledge of the other, and have a good command of English.
Nice to Haves

• Experience within the insurance or financial domain.
• Experience on projects involving different technology stacks and integration aspects.
• Professional and client-friendly approach.

jobs.occupation: Become a Forklift Operator at a Sustainable Recycling Company
jobs.description:
As a forklift operator, you’ll join an innovative plastic recycling company where sustainability and circular economy are at the heart of what we do. In this role, you’ll be responsible for moving plastic waste around the site, loading and unloading trucks, and performing minor technical maintenance. Your work directly contributes to recycling plastic and building a greener future.

On a typical workday, you’ll work in one of two shifts: early shift from 5 AM to 2 PM, or late shift from 2 PM to 11 PM (sometimes 3 PM to 12 AM), always with a one-hour break. You’ll use a wheel loader and forklift to efficiently process plastic waste. Flexibility is important, as the shift schedule can vary slightly. Please note, the nature of recycling means the work environment can be less clean and sometimes involve odors. You’ll handle small technical issues yourself, while a maintenance technician is available for larger problems.

Are you ready to put your technical skills to good use and make a positive impact on the environment? Apply now and make a difference as an operator in the recycling industry!

• You have a valid forklift license

• You speak good English; knowledge of Dutch is an asset

• You have technical knowledge and can handle minor repairs or maintenance

• You’re flexible for early and late shift work

• Experience in a similar role is a plus, but not required

• You work accurately and value safety

As a Technical Support Advisor, you are the point of contact for BEA's business customers throughout Europe, with a particular history in the German-speaking area. 

Your missions:
 
Customer & internal technical support
  
• Answer customers' technical questions by phone, WhatsApp or e-mail, with a particular focus on VIP customers and high-value sensors. 
• Diagnose faults remotely and propose concrete solutions 
• Support our customers' technicians in the installation, wiring and configuration of BEA sensors. 
• Manage incoming calls from the technical hotline for Europe and provide product support to the European sales team. 
• Provide ongoing internal support in conjunction with other members of the technical team. 
• Participate in the creation, optimization and coordination of technical documentation (e.g. wiring diagrams, instructions) for customers in the field.  
Continuous improvement & documentation
  
• Collect and transmit relevant field feedback to the sales, product and R&D teams, in a logic of continuous improvement. 
• Write reports and feed the internal knowledge base, to promote the sharing of expertise within the company (sales, marketing, product). 
• Define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) related to the quality of service and products, using a ticketing system, to measure customer satisfaction and identify areas for improvement. 
• Participate in product tests (BEA sensors and competitors) in collaboration with Product Management and R&D teams. 
• Organize the planning of customer visits by the technical team.  
Team
 
You will join the sales department, within the Pedestrian Door Detectors (PES) segment.
 
Your direct technical referent, Sandra, currently holds this position, which she knows like the back of her hand. She will still be active in customer technical support, with a stronger focus on internal training, while actively supporting you during your integration. Trilingual, rigorous, challenging and always available, she ensures that customers receive impeccable service.

Your experience and education: 
 
• Minimum 2 years of experience in a support function 
• Strong interest in electronic, electromechanical or connected solutions 
• Good command of office tools and ability to read technical guides 
• Excellent command of German, French and English (spoken and written)  
Your soft skills and personal qualities:
  
• Excellent interpersonal skills, ability to ask the right questions and reassure customers 
• Curiosity, thirst for learning and spirit of investigation 
• Method, rigor and stress management 
• Taste for teamwork and openness to feedback 
• Ability to interact with different internal contact (PM, sales, R&D, quality)

About K-Boringen:With its trenchless installation of pipelines and tunnels, K-Boringen has built a groundbreaking international reputation. Equipped with an extensive fleet of machinery and supported by more than 55 expert employees, K-Boringen guarantees an extremely smooth and flexible service, even in the most challenging work situations. To ensure continued growth, we are currently looking for new colleagues.Being naturally multilingual and equipped with an impressive machine park, the people at K-Boringen ensure an exceptionally smooth and flexible collaboration, even in the most demanding work conditions.Using tunnel boring machines, our professionals drill (micro)tunnels with diameters of up to 4 meters over lengths of, for example, 1 km. More information can be found at https://www.k-boringen.com/.To carry out our drilling projects across Europe, we are looking for motivated, competent employees who have a sense of responsibility and adventure. Our target group consists of workers who are eager to work—especially on-site abroad—who are flexible and skilled in languages.

During weekends, you return home (you also receive a daily allowance for accommodation).You will not work every week of the year; there will be both busy periods (when execution takes place) and quieter periods.A driver’s license is not required.

• Advise clients on the structuring and set-up of investment funds (PE & VC)
• Support the full lifecycle of funds, from formation to ongoing operations
• Assist with drafting and reviewing fund documentation and agreements
• Contribute to capital raising processes and investor-related documentation
• Provide support on regulatory and compliance matters relevant to investment funds
• Conduct legal research and analysis on complex fund-related topics
• Work closely with senior lawyers and directly interact with clients on active matters

• Belgian Master's degree in Law with strong academic results
• A first experience in Corporate and M&A

• Analytical mindset with strong attention to detail

Our client is a global engineeringandsupply-chain services provider operating across 17 countries and supporting more than 25 industrial customers worldwide. They work with leading companies in sectors such as aerospace, automotive, medical devices, marine, energy, and precision machining. To strengthen their team in Belgium, they are looking for a Site Engineer who will support a demanding aerospace client on-site , working closely with production and manufacturing engineering teams.

Jobomschrijving

• Support customer manufacturing engineering teams on tooling, cutting tools, abrasives, and machining processes.
• Troubleshoot technical issues, provide recommendations, and ensure reliable technical service on the production floor.
• Analyse production needs, propose alternatives, and support optimisation projects.
• Collaborate with supply and logistics teams to ensure smooth workflow and on-time delivery.
• Ensure availability of critical tooling and support inventory optimisation.
• Act as the primary technical contact for the on-site customer.
• Build strong relationships with production engineers, management, and tooling suppliers.
• Support cost-saving initiatives and contribute to productivity improvements. 
• Monitor technical KPIs: delivery performance, tooling reliability, cost optimisation, etc.
• Collaborate with the local Belgian team (supply chain, logistics, junior engineer).
• Provide guidance and support to junior and operational staff as needed.

• Master's degree in Mechanical or Electromechanical Engineering or related field.
• minimum of 5 years of experience in a manufacturing environment (aerospace, automotive, medical devices, CNC machining, marine, or energy or other relevant field).
• Experience in production engineering or manufacturing engineering is preferred.
• Experience in supply chain environments is an advantage.
• Hands-on mentality and strong problem-solving capability.

• English & French (professional working proficiency).

jobs.occupation: Executive Assistant to VP - Zaventem - Medical Industry
jobs.description:
Our client is an international medical technology company dedicated to improving patient outcomes through innovative, clinically proven solutions in key areas of care. They believe that ideas can come from anywhere, and they encourage employees at every level to make a difference.

Jobomschrijving

Provide full administrative support to the VP, including calendar management, prioritization of meetings, screening calls and emails, and coordinating daily tasks.

Prepare executive summaries, meeting pre-reads, and contract materials to ensure the VP is well-informed for all engagements.

Manage budgets, vendor selection, contract negotiation, and on-site logistics for off-site meetings and conferences in coordination with procurement.

Oversee business travel and visa arrangements, and ensure timely, accurate submission of expense reports.

Create polished PowerPoint presentations, respond professionally to internal and external inquiries, and maintain discretion with sensitive information.

Build and maintain strong relationships with global and external stakeholders, support strategic meetings, training, events, and team-building activities across Europe.

Develop robust knowledge of the business's structure, tools, policies, and key contacts, support sensitive employee matters, and ensure completion of required training.

Organizational & Problem-Solving Skills: Strong planning, attention to detail, ability to multitask, prioritize, and resolve issues independently.
